articles.headline: Boston's Rafaela, back from IL, injures hamstring while running out single
articles.description: Ceddanne Rafaela, who returned Wednesday after being sidelined since Sept. 3 with a right quad strain, left in the third inning with tightness in his right hamstring.

articles.headline: Blue Jays' Guerrero stands by comments about contract extension
articles.description: Blue Jays first baseman Vladimir Guerrero Jr. is standing by comments he made during a recent interview regarding his performance this season after signing a 14-year, $500 million contract last year.

images.name: Vladimir Guerrero Jr. of Toronto Blue Jays [600x400]
images.caption: Blue Jays first baseman Vladimir Guerrero Jr. sat out his third straight game Friday because of a sore hamstring.

articles.headline: Stanton, Grisham take steps toward rejoining Yankees
articles.description: Yankees slugger Giancarlo Stanton could return for the playoffs after a 5½-month absence due to calf strains.

articles.headline: Counsell says Cubs at disadvantage after schedule change
articles.description: Cubs manager Craig Counsell was quick to point out the disadvantages his team faces this weekend after the league moved Sunday's contest against the Boston Red Sox to Friday due to a poor weather forecast.

images.name: Craig Counsell [600x400]
images.caption: Can Craig Counsell and the Cubs take a step forward in the NL Central? Here's what will decide a crucial season for Chicago.

articles.headline: Walker Jenkins' pinch-hit RBI single in the 7th keys Twins' 4-2 victory over Giants
articles.description: — Pinch-hitter Walker Jenkins hit an RBI single in the seventh inning that put Minnesota ahead and the Twins won their second straight over the San Francisco Giants with a 4-2 victory on Wednesday.

images.name: Twins take the series over the Giants with 4-2 win
images.caption: Twins take the series over the Giants with 4-2 win

articles.headline: Dodgers' Shohei Ohtani returns from IL stint, starts vs. Padres
articles.description: Dodgers star Shohei Ohtani, who was on the injured list since Sept. 8, was activated and in the starting lineup for Wednesday's game against the Padres.

images.name: Shohei Ohtani [1296x729]
images.caption: Shohei Ohtani is ready to get off the bench and back into the Dodgers batting order.
images.alt: Shohei Ohtani #17 of the Los Angeles Dodgers looks on from the dugout during the first inning against the Seattle Mariners at Dodger Stadium.
